title: Book Two · Chapter 32: Tuesday on the Board
story:
On Thursday, Miss Wu writes TUESDAY on the board.

She puts a little line under the word. Ronan looks up from his number book.

“Our reading task will be next Tuesday,” she says. “You will each have a page. You will read and answer three questions.”

Leo turns his pencil between his fingers.

“Which story?”

“A new one.”

“Can we choose a partner?” Jun asks.

“Not for this task. You will work alone. You can ask me about the instructions.”

Ronan looks towards the cupboard. The shared cards are inside. His and Jun's card will stay there.

“Will the page be long?” he asks.

“About as long as our other short pages.”

He looks at the word TUESDAY again. There are several days before it.

Miss Wu holds up an empty sheet. She draws three little spaces below the title.

“These are the questions. There is no need to race to the bottom.”

Ronan puts his hands flat beside his book. He wants to ask about first place again. This time he keeps quiet.

The class returns to the number lesson. They count small groups on the board. Ronan gets the first answer right. The next one needs another look.

At break, Leo says Tuesday will be easy.

“You did not see the page,” Ronan says.

“Neither did you.”

“I did not say it was easy.”

Leo grins. “Then we can both find out on Tuesday.”

Jun asks them to come outside. He has made two new chalk lines. One is too close to a wet patch. They move the game farther from the wall.

Ronan rolls the ball slowly. It stops between the lines. He lifts one hand.

Leo rolls next. His ball touches the line.

“Does that count?”

They look at Jun.

“Outside,” Jun says. “That was the rule yesterday.”

Leo picks up the ball. He does not move the line this time.

After school, Ronan copies TUESDAY onto a clean corner of his own paper. He draws three small squares beside it.

Mum sees the paper at home.

“Do you need something for school?”

“Only my pencil. We will read alone.”

“Then put your pencil in your bag the night before.”

“Can I read to you tonight?”

“For a little while after dinner.”

She puts his paper on the shelf, clear of the thread. Ronan leaves the three squares empty. He cannot put answers in them yet.

Dad comes home with a mark of dust on his sleeve. Ronan shows him the date.

“Next Tuesday,” Dad reads.

“Three questions.”

“Three chances to look carefully.”

Ronan wants Dad to say he will do well. Dad asks about his school day instead.

Ronan tells him about the ball on the line. Dad asks Jun's rule. Ronan explains it.

At dinner, he leaves the date paper beside his bag. It is still there later, while he reads a few lines to Mum. She listens, then asks him to read the first line once more.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

alone＝独自；instruction＝要求、说明；count＝算数、计入；carefully＝仔细地。

## 理解问题

1. 老师为周二的任务确定了哪些要求？
2. Leo为什么不能提前确定故事一定容易？

## 读句子

You / will work / alone.＝你们／会做这项任务／各自独立地。
